crossRefs.note: and saying, “If you are the King of the Jews, save yourself!”

parallels.note: Now it was the Preparation Day of the Passover, at about the sixth hour. He said to the Jews, “Behold, your King!”

translations.web: and saying, “If you are the King of the Jews, save yourself!”
translations.bsb: “If You are the King of the Jews,” they said, “save Yourself!”
translations.kjv: And saying, If thou be the king of the Jews, save thyself.
translations.asv: and saying, If thou art the King of the Jews, save thyself.
